summary: Markets are digesting Friday's surprising July jobs report which showed a loss of 23,000 jobs versus expectations of 80,000 gains, with unemployment ticking down to 4.1%. The S&P 500 closed at a record 7,757.64 on Friday, up 0.62%, while the Nasdaq climbed 1.3% to 26,690.62 as investors interpreted the weak employment data as reducing the likelihood of Fed rate hikes. Geopolitical risks have eased with progress on Strait of Hormuz negotiations, driving oil prices down over 7% for the week. Amazon surged 17% weekly after beating earnings and demonstrating strong AI infrastructure returns, while mega-cap tech earnings season has shown robust 29% year-over-year S&P 500 earnings growth. Bitcoin firmed to $65,143 and Ethereum to $1,929 following the jobs miss, as the crypto Fear & Greed Index improved from extreme fear to 29. The Fed held rates steady at its July 29 meeting with three dissents favoring hikes, keeping the 'higher for longer' narrative intact despite weakening labor data.

signals.title: July jobs report shocks with 23K losses, cooling Fed rate hike expectations
signals.desc: Economists expected 80,000 job gains but instead saw losses, sharply reducing odds of Fed tightening and lifting equities and crypto.

signals.title: S&P 500 closes at record 7,757.64 as tech mega-caps surge on AI earnings strength
signals.desc: Amazon jumped 17% weekly while S&P 500 earnings are tracking 29% year-over-year growth, with mega-caps driving nearly half of 2026 EPS gains.

signals.title: Oil plunges 7% weekly as Strait of Hormuz deal progresses, easing geopolitical risk
signals.desc: Treasury Secretary Bessent indicated a deal could come imminently to reopen the strait, sending WTI down 5.7% to $75.77 and Brent down 5.3% to $79.36.

signals.title: Fed dissent intensifies with three members voting for hikes at July meeting
signals.desc: Despite holding rates at 3.5%-3.75%, three FOMC members dissented in favor of tightening, signaling inflation concerns persist and rate cuts remain distant.

signals.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum consolidate near $65K and $1,930 as regulatory clarity stalls
signals.desc: Crypto investors await progress on the Clarity Act through Congress while institutional activity remains muted despite improved sentiment from extreme fear.

verdict: Risk-on rally extends on dovish labor data and easing geopolitical tensions, but Fed dissent and AI capex scrutiny warrant caution into next week.
